description.en: Composer screenshot button for DSH with native full-desktop region selection, hidden-window capture, full-screen and last-region reuse, a Ctrl+Shift+S shortcut, and an optional model-facing screenshot tool that asks for confirmation before every capture.
description.zh: DSH 的输入框截图按钮：系统级框选整个桌面、隐藏窗口后截图、整屏与上次选区复用、Ctrl+Shift+S 快捷键，并带一个每次截图前都会询问的模型侧截图工具。
